The learned counsel appearing for the respondent submits that the writ petition has become infructuous, because the State Government of Karnataka has banned manufacture, sale and distribution of gutkha, pan masala and all other forms of chewing Tobacco containing tobacco and nicotine, in whatsoever form w.e.f. 30.05.2013.
3.
In view of the aforesaid submissions, the present petition has become infructuous.
